title: QFBench 2.0 Track-2 forecast output (forecast_meta.json sidecar)
description: Describes a probabilistic JOINT predictive distribution over assets x horizons as of `asof`. The bulk numbers live in forecast.parquet; this sidecar declares representation and indexing. Gate g1_schema validates this AND checks that forecast_rationale.md exists next to forecast.parquet and is non-empty (a filesystem check on the fixed filename; the optional `rationale` key here is declaration only); g2_cutoff verifies asof precedes every target timestamp and that all input panel data AND text-corpus documents have timestamps <= asof (text is an INPUT to the agent, not part of this output schema).

representation.description: samples => forecast.parquet has columns [draw:int, asset:str, horizon:int, value:float]; parametric => [asset, horizon, mean] plus cov.parquet (lower-tri) per horizon.

horizons.description: forecast horizons in business days/months as declared by the card.

n_draws.description: required when representation=='samples'; CRPS estimator variance ~ 1/n_draws.

rationale.description: OPTIONAL declaration of the derivation behind the submitted distribution. The FILE forecast_rationale.md is REQUIRED — gate g1 checks the filesystem directly, next to forecast.parquet, so this sidecar key is a declaration only and its absence cannot fail a submission. The file is NEVER SCORED: no submission is ranked higher or lower because of it, and no scoring code may read its content. It exists because a submission that recalled its answer and one that derived it are indistinguishable as a set of draws. Read only as a review screen over the top of the leaderboard; a flag opens a human review and cannot by itself produce a DNF or move a score.

method.description: optional one-line summary, e.g. 'random walk + text-adjusted drift'
